sloka: अथ विनदति सादिते निकुम्भे पवनसुतेन रणे बभूव युद्धम्।दशरथसुतराक्षसेन्द्रसून्वोर्भृशतरमागतरोषयोः सुभीमम् ।। ६.७७.२४ ।।
transliteration: atha vinadati sādite nikumbhe pavanasutena raṇe babhūva yuddham।daśarathasutarākṣasendrasūnvorbhṛśataramāgataroṣayoḥ subhīmam ।। 6.77.24 ।।

translations.english: When the life departed from Nikumbha, the rejoicing monkeys roared and the quarters resounded with their cry; the earth seemed to shake, the very sky seemed to fall, and fear seized the army of the rakshasas.
